responsibility: Implements GCC’s compile-time coverage/profile file management around gcno/gcda data. This file allocates per-function counter variables, reads existing gcda counts for profile-use, emits gcno notes and the gcov_info/gcov_fn_info objects describing instrumented functions, computes and tracks per-function identifiers and checksums, and performs file-level initialization/finalization for coverage, PGO, and AutoFDO startup. It is the compiler-side owner of coverage object construction and of mapping GCC functions and counters to serialized gcov records.
same_name_distinction: This file is the compiler-side implementation of gcno/gcda management: it allocates counters, reads counts, emits notes/data descriptors, and performs file-level initialization/finalization, even including the gcov I/O implementation via gcov-io.cc. Unlike gcc/coverage.h, it contains the concrete coverage object construction and serialization-driving logic rather than just declarations.
